title: Treaty of Altranstädt (1707)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Altranstädt (1707)", at revision 1312269383, opens: "The Treaty or Convention of Altranstädt was signed between Charles XII of Sweden and Joseph I, Holy Roman Emperor on 31 August 1707. It settled the rights of Protestants in Silesia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1812583, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1707 treaty between Sweden and the Holy Roman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
